scripts.build: pnpm --filter @vibecloud/core build && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/ai build && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/db build && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/telemetry build && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/cli build && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/codex-skill-init build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:scripts && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/ai typecheck && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/telemetry exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/codex-skill-init typecheck && pnpm typecheck:tests
scripts.test: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck:scripts && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/core test:unit && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/ai test:unit && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/db test:unit && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/telemetry test:unit && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/codex-skill-init test:unit && pnpm --filter @vibecloud/cli test:unit && node --test scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.release:check: pnpm test && node scripts/release-check.ts && node scripts/generated-project-acceptance.ts && node scripts/live-yc-acceptance.ts
